title: Peak Experiences Richmond
specs: One of the largest adaptive climbing programs in the state
Hundreds of top rope routes, lead only areas, auto belays, and bouldering
Must be 16 or older to be trained and certified to operate auto belay systems
Participants 10 years or younger must be accompanied by an adult in bouldering areas
No one 16 years or younger may enter fitness areas
To belay, must pass belay certification test; minimum age 13 for belaying
Minimum weight for auto belay use is 25 lbs, maximum 300 lbs
Climbers must wear closed-toe shoes; no bare feet
All climbers and observers must have signed Assumption of Risks form
Climbers must use harnesses designed for climbing; rentals provided if needed

blurb: Peak Experiences offers indoor climbing with top rope, lead climbing, auto belays, and bouldering. They provide climbing instruction, fitness classes, youth and adaptive climbing programs, and host birthday parties and group events. Facilities include two locations with climbing gear rental and retail shop.
extraNote: $100 deposit for Late Night Climbing is non-refundable but transferable if rescheduled more than 30 days out · $60 deposit for birthday parties is transferable and applied to total party price · Everyone entering must have a current Assumption of Risk form · No alcohol or controlled substances allowed before or during climbing · Belay certifications must be passed for each device used · Memberships can be canceled at any time; Belong Program memberships are 6 months long with no freezes
